lines.speaker: Uncle Sirisena
lines.text: Jayantha sent it. Very reliable fellow. He knows somebody at the municipal office. Or his cousin does. One of those.

lines.speaker: Uncle Sirisena
lines.text: Why — you doubt it? Karu, this is an election. Things happen fast. Better safe, no?

choices.label: Forward it. Jayantha sounds reliable enough.
Go check the Elections Commission notice board to confirm.
